title: Ingredients to Look for in a Night Cream: A Simple Guide
ex: Which night cream ingredients suit which goal, a side-by-side comparison, and how to read a label before you buy.
rt: Ingredients to Look for in a Night Cream | Mirc Glow
rd: Ingredients to look for in a night cream: niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, alpha arbutin, kojic acid and more compared, plus how to read a label before buying.
keyword: ingredients to look for in a night cream
quick: The right night cream ingredients depend on your goal: hyaluronic acid and plant oils for dryness, niacinamide for the skin barrier, and alpha arbutin or kojic acid for a more even-looking tone. Choose a moisturising base with one or two targeted ingredients.
facts: Ingredients are usually listed from most to least.
One or two actives in a cream is plenty.
Kojic acid is typically around 1–2% in creams.
Use sunscreen daily with alpha arbutin or kojic acid.
